newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady to slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to slightly higher.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to slightly firmer on a quiet Tuesday morning, dealers said.
The strength of prompt gasoline passed into the first half of August, with deliveries then offered at around $204 fob Rotterdam. This left them sharply higher than August swaps which held under $200.
Heating oil barges were little changed as IPE August gas oil futures hovered from 25 to 50 cents higher.
End July discussions were almost finished. Early August loadings were offered at around IPE August +75 cents/+$1 fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barge offers rose slightly with offers at $90.50 for end July loading and $1 higher for first half August. One prompt RMG barge traded at $89.50.
Bunker market demand was low. -- Philip Blenkinsop, Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5000
